10771.author: quinnanm
10771.body:
update hls4mlEmulatorExtras to [v1.1.7](https://github.com/cms-hls4ml/hls4mlEmulatorExtras/releases/tag/v1.1.7)
adds fix for early model destruction https://github.com/cms-hls4ml/hls4mlEmulatorExtras/issues/7 as included in https://github.com/cms-hls4ml/hls4mlEmulatorExtras/pull/8 (avoid early dlclose call). Spotted in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51633

Also adds fix to shared pointer type mismatch found [here](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmsdist/pull/10770#issuecomment-5218468633) and other bugs as mentioned below. Verified compilation.

Backport of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmsdist/pull/10770
10771.title: [20_0_X] Update hls4mlEmulatorExtras to v1.1.7 (backport)

51689.author: AdrianoDee
51689.body:
#### PR description:

This PR proposes a realignment of the 20_0_X order for `Run4D12*` geometries to the one used in `master`. Personally, I don't like this too much since it pushes D121 `GenOnly` and `SimOnGen` flavors to the bottom. But this is the less painful transition that allows us to keep the `37600` offset for D127 (the new baseline).

#### PR validation:

Let's the bot do this.
51689.title: [20_0_X] Re-align D12* Geometry Order to `master`
